description: This Java source file defines the class 'LoanTestAccounts' which is part of integration tests for the Apache Fineract project. It manages different account types (asset, liability, income, expense) used in testing loan-related functionalities, providing constructors and methods to access specific account IDs based on account names.

classes.name: LoanTestAccounts
classes.description: A class that encapsulates various account objects related to loan testing, providing methods to fetch account IDs based on account names.

methods.name: getAssetAccountId
methods.description: Returns the ID of an asset account based on the provided account name.

methods.name: getLiabilityAccountId
methods.description: Returns the ID of a liability account based on the provided account name.

methods.name: getIncomeAccountId
methods.description: Returns the ID of an income account based on the provided account name.

methods.name: getExpenseAccountId
methods.description: Returns the ID of an expense account based on the provided account name.
